questions.q: Which form of hablar goes with nosotros?
questions.explanation: Regular -ar verbs add -amos for nosotros: hablamos.

questions.q: querer is an e→ie stem-changing verb. Which form does NOT change its stem?
questions.explanation: Nosotros (queremos) never changes its stem in an e→ie verb, because the stress doesn't fall on the stem vowel in that form.

questions.q: What is the correct yo-form of despertarse (reflexive + e→ie)?
questions.explanation: The reflexive pronoun me agrees with yo, and the e→ie stem change applies: me despierto.

questions.q: hacer, salir, and poner share what kind of irregularity?
options: They're irregular only in the yo-form
questions.explanation: hago, salgo, and pongo are irregular only in the yo-form; every other form follows the regular pattern.

questions.q: Which sentence correctly uses soler + infinitive to describe a habitual weekday routine?
questions.explanation: Soler must be conjugated to match the subject and followed directly by an infinitive — never by que, and never by another conjugated or past-participle form.

questions.q: Complete accurately: 'Entre semana tengo mucha tarea; ___, casi no tengo tiempo para el ocio.'
questions.explanation: Por eso connects the cause (a lot of homework) directly to its effect (almost no time for leisure).
